title: Integrate four parallel match-sim mechanic slices (ball physics, locomotion, kick, first touch) so replays stay deterministic and the plan holds
derivation: Faithful TypeScript port of the merged GDScript MatchSim phase-one history: core scaffold (#9: fixed-tick loop, SimRng, MatchConfig, MatchLog, InputProvider incl. AI/Scripted/Network, headless CLI run loop) and golden-replay harness (#10), then tasks 1.1 ball physics (#11, BallPhysics), 1.2 locomotion (#14, Locomotion), 1.3 kick mechanics (#16, Kick) and 1.4 first touch (#17, FirstTouch), ported function-by-function at reference_ref d682688 (MatchSim wiring, tuning keys, constants, event shapes, tick order, touch arbitration, digest fields and the AI provider are line-for-line). The oracle additionally carries the real rolling-resistance fix from #18 (bfef6bd: constant deceleration instead of proportional damping, which the history calls 'wrong, not just mistuned'). Port notes: Godot Vector2/Vector3/wrapf/move_toward semantics are reimplemented in vec.ts; SimRng is the PCG32 generator Godot's RandomNumberGenerator uses with simplified float sampling, so logs are deterministic within the port but not bit-identical to Godot output; String.hash is djb2; the Gym provider stub, presentation/debug code, selftest and gdUnit suites are omitted; enums become const objects for Node type stripping. Orchestration framing (synthetic): instead of landing sequentially, the four slices are presented as dispatched in parallel from the scaffold and landed unintegrated, carrying realistic cross-slice integration defects (all listed in audited_base_defects): an unseeded Math.random side-spin jitter breaking replay determinism, snapshot/digest omitting state added by S1/S2, a stamina fraction-vs-points scale mismatch that disables sprinting, the kick charge read under a brief's field name instead of the input contract's kick_power, the first-touch receive path never wired (mis-split briefs), the real pre-#18 proportional friction, and a leftover scaffold position update integrating the ball twice per tick. The base is the reference port with exactly these defects; plan and briefs are sanitized excerpts written for the package.
required_environment: Godot 4.3 headless (GDScript MatchSim, gdUnit4 golden-replay suite, Linux CI runner for the platform-specific golden fixture); this package grades the faithful TypeScript port under Node 24 only.
coverage: Behavioral scenarios on held-out seeds, inputs and states for all 7 plan requirements: byte-identical AI and record/replay logs, digest/snapshot coverage via perturbation, ball physics (rolling deceleration, stop, bounce, single integration, Magnus, spin decay, gravity, clamp), locomotion (start stamina, sprint, strict threshold, analog, drain/recovery/cap, aim, clamp), kick (type/power/aim/goal fallback/unknown type/clamp/event/possession), first touch (modes, rounded quality, cooldown boundary, trigger boundary, kicker precedence, no-input, seeded bounded error, spin, possession), goals/restarts/goal-mouth boundaries/wall rebounds, touch arbitration (distance, tie, reach, height, cooldown boundary, commits); plus a closed-vocabulary integration ledger (exact required set, decoys rejected, locations, requirement mapping, dependency-respecting landing order).
historical_exposure: Private repository; GDScript originals are not public, and the TypeScript port with injected integration defects has low recognition risk.
residual_rubric: Code style, comments, brief quality and any golden fixture are not graded.

audited_base_defects.evidence: Kick.build side-spin bias is (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * side_spin_jitter instead of this.rng.jitter(...), so same-seed AI and replayed matches diverge (R1)

state_digest (line 364) hashes ball position/velocity and player position/velocity only - no spin, facing or stamina (lines 369-371); BallState.to_dict omits wx/wy/wz (ball_state.ts:33) and PlayerState.to_dict omits facing/stamina/sprinting (player_state.ts:31) (R2)
spawn sets stamina = 1.0 as a 0..1 fraction (player_state.ts:7) while Locomotion compares and drains stamina in points against stamina_sprint_min 5 / stamina_max 100, so nobody can ever sprint (R4)
_kick_ball reads cmd.power (KickInput, kick.ts:27) but the input contract field is kick_power, so every strike uses full power and logs power 1 (R5)
_resolve_touches skips every player without kick:true and only calls _kick_ball (line 276); FirstTouch is never imported, tuned or called, so no player ever receives the ball (R6)

rolling friction scales ground velocity by (1 - ground_friction*dt) (lines 71-72), a speed-proportional damping, instead of a constant ground_friction m/s^2 deceleration (R3; real defect fixed upstream in #18)
_integrate_ball advances position again after BallPhysics.apply_forces already integrated it, so the ball moves twice per tick (R3)

audited_absent.tick-order: tick() runs _update_players, _resolve_touches, _integrate_ball, _resolve_bounds, _track_possession then increments tick_count, exactly the plan's order; the extra position update is inside the ball step (double-apply), not a reordering
audited_absent.aim-coupling: Locomotion.update_aim only turns facing toward a non-zero aim input and keeps it otherwise; velocity never sets facing; _kick_ball falls back to facing only when the aim input is zero, as the plan states

decisions: Scope is tasks 1.1-1.4 (#11-#17) on the #9/#10 core; task 1.5 tackling (#20) and the #18 dribble / #19 possession model are out of scope to keep the port faithful and the package within one integration session.
base_ref is the commit with the core scaffold and golden harness (347ffd5, #10) rather than bc1959d (#8), because the agent starts from the scaffold.

Record/replay is defined the way the upstream code supports it: recorded per-tick inputs replayed through ScriptedProvider.per_tick with the same seed; AI providers draw from sim.rng, so the original AI run is not required to equal its input replay.
